svg.title: Effective value of PC Optimum examples at 10 dollars per 10,000 points
svg.desc: Bars from the PC Optimum Program Benefits table as of 29 Sep 2026. A table example of 15,000 points on 100 dollars is worth 15 dollars, or 15 percent. A table example of 25,000 points on 250 dollars is worth 25 dollars, or 10 percent. Base earn of 15 points per dollar on eligible Shoppers products is 1.5 percent. Not a live beauty flyer.
svg.text: Points value as a share of spend
Benefits table, as of 29 Sep 2026. 10 dollars per 10,000 points.
15,000 points = 15 dollars. 25,000 points = 25 dollars. 1,500 points = 1 dollar and 50 cents.
The first two bars are examples printed on the benefits table, not a current flyer.
Base earn applies to eligible products in the Shoppers column. Grocery varies by province.
